# opusdns_report (Data Source)

Reads a generated OpusDNS report by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opusdns_report" "example" {
  report_id = "report_01jxe1zw90f1t8vgpyfns8qwk1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `report_id` (String) Report id (`report_...`).

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String)
- `file_size_bytes` (Number)
- `generated_on` (String)
- `id` (String) Mirror of `report_id`.
- `organization_id` (String)
- `record_count` (Number)
- `report_type` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `trigger_type` (String)
- `updated_on` (String)
